title: 2 MW DG sets
description: 4 x 2 MW 11 kV diesel generator sets with acoustic enclosures, fuel day tanks, synchronising panel, exhaust stacks, NGRs and 11 kV cabling for Project Alpha.
default_goal_text: Get the 2 MW DG sets for Project Alpha ordered by 2027-04-30 within budget ₹38 Cr
po_terms: Liquidated damages: 0.5% of order value per week (or part) of delay beyond the contractual delivery date, capped at 10% of order value.
Warranty: 24 months from commissioning or 30 months from delivery, whichever is earlier, or 5,000 running hours; defects rectified at site within 72 h of notice.
Factory acceptance test: witnessed load test per ISO 8528-6 (100% / 110% load, transient response), 5 days, Owner and Engineer present; despatch only after signed FAT report.
Submittals: GA, foundation and exhaust layouts, fuel schematic, alternator data, synchronising logic and protection settings within 14 days of PO; Engineer review 10 days.
Compliance: ISO 8528, IEC 60034 alternators, CPCB IV+ / MoEFCC emission norms with type-approval certificate enclosed before PO release, PESO approval for fuel storage where applicable.
Bank guarantees: advance against ABG of equal value; 10% performance bank guarantee valid for the warranty period plus 3 months.
Price basis: firm, ex-GST; GST 18% charged on invoice per prevailing law.
